_about: A certification-style exam for testers, written for this example (not real exam questions). Every exam is an evaluation too: it has an oracle (the answer key), questions that can be ambiguous, sometimes two defensible answers, and questions that may have leaked into training data. 'reviewers' holds what two experienced testers said when they reviewed the exam.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of a test oracle?

options.A: To decide whether an observed result is correct

questions.question: Which of these is a non-functional quality characteristic of an online shop?
At which test level are the interactions between integrated components tested?

options.A: Testing that confirms changes have not broken behaviour that worked before
options.B: Testing that checks a fix for one defect
options.D: Testing of the oldest features first

questions.question: Which technique is BEST for testing a field that accepts ages from 18 to 65?

reviewers.note: both are standard for this field; 'BEST' is a test of the exam's wording, not of skill

questions.question: Which is a benefit of static testing?

options.A: Defects can be found before the code is executed

questions.question: What does the test basis consist of?

options.A: The documents and sources from which test cases are derived
options.B: The minimum set of tests run before every release

questions.question: When should testing activities start in the development lifecycle?
A tester sees that a chatbot gives different answers to the same question. What is the MOST appropriate first step?

options.B: Run the question several times and record the variation
options.C: Ask the developers to fix the random seed
options.D: Ignore it, because language models are random

reviewers.note: for a system built on an LLM, B is the better first step; the key reflects deterministic-software thinking

questions.question: What is the difference between a defect and a failure?

options.A: A defect is a flaw in a work product; a failure is the deviation observed when it is executed
options.C: A failure is found in reviews; a defect is found in execution
options.D: A defect is reported by users; a failure by testers

questions.question: Which metric BEST shows test progress?

options.B: Percentage of requirements covered by passed tests

reviewers.note: 'best' depends on the project and the audience; reviewers disagreed with each other

questions.question: Which activity belongs to test analysis?

options.A: Identifying testable features and defining test conditions
